-- Synthetic LearnPath AI demo data for MySQL.
-- Run learnpath_ai_database.sql first, then run this file once in the fresh learnpath_ai database.
-- All people, scores, and assignments below are fictional sample data.
-- For login-enabled demos, replace @demo_password_hash with a hash generated by your application.
-- Never replace it with a plaintext password or commit a real password/hash to a public repository.
